WITH summary AS (
  SELECT 
    event_status,
    AVG(remaining) as status_avg,
    (SELECT AVG(remaining) FROM budget WHERE remaining IS NOT NULL) as overall_avg
  FROM budget
  WHERE remaining IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY event_status
)
SELECT 
  event_status,
  status_avg,
  status_avg - overall_avg as difference
FROM summary
WHERE overall_avg IS NOT NULL;

alternatives.interpretation: Calculate the amount left over directly as (amount - spent) from source columns, rather than using the pre-calculated remaining column, which may be preferred to validate data consistency or if the remaining column is suspected to be stale.

WITH summary AS (
  SELECT 
    event_status,
    AVG(amount - spent) as status_avg,
    (SELECT AVG(amount - spent) FROM budget WHERE amount IS NOT NULL AND spent IS NOT NULL) as overall_avg
  FROM budget
  WHERE amount IS NOT NULL AND spent IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY event_status
)
SELECT 
  event_status,
  status_avg,
  status_avg - overall_avg as difference
FROM summary
WHERE overall_avg IS NOT NULL;
